caption: The drawing shows a single wooden chair rendered with detailed shading and color. The chair is primarily a reddish-brown wood color, with ornate and curved front legs featuring scroll and carved detailing, ending in claw-like feet. The rear legs are plain and curve backward in a gentle arc. The seat is a soft, padded rectangle, covered in a mauve or dusty rose fabric. The backrest is relatively low with a top rail that is curved and scrolls outward at the ends, and a lower section that includes a decorative, openwork design. The chair is centered on a plain, off-white or cream-colored background, and there are no other objects or elements depicted in the composition. The artist's signature, "ARTHUR JOHNSON," is faintly visible at the bottom left corner.
title: Side Chair
